pretreatment: rinsed with methanol, acetone, and deionized water and then blown free of particles
surface_functionalization: annealing at 875 K for 1 min and a H2O plasma discharge at room temperature to remove surface carbon
evidence: The Si(100) substrates were rinsed with methanol, acetone, and deionized water and then blown free of particles before loading into the deposition chamber. The Si(100) surface was first cleaned by annealing at 875 K for 1 min. Subsequently, a H2O plasma discharge at room temperature was utilized to remove surface carbon.
